about.body: The Ford EcoBoost is a Inline-4 (I4), 2.0L (1,999 cc), Petrol engine used across Jaguar's several model range, in production 2012–2015. We rebuild every Ford EcoBoost to original specification, replacing worn timing components, bearings, gaskets and seals as standard.

byModel.body: The Ford EcoBoost is deployed across the Ford EcoBoost (Ford EcoBoost / Ford EcoBoost, Ford EcoBoost), the Ford EcoBoost (Ford EcoBoost / Ford EcoBoost, Ford EcoBoost), and the Ford EcoBoost (Ford EcoBoost / Ford EcoBoost, Ford EcoBoost). These form the core of the high-performance Ford EcoBoost range. More recently, the engine has been adopted for the Ford EcoBoost (Ford EcoBoost, Ford EcoBoost), the Ford EcoBoost (Ford EcoBoost, Ford EcoBoost), and the Ford EcoBoost roadster (Ford EcoBoost, Ford EcoBoost), proving the Ford EcoBoost's versatility across different vehicle types.

compatibility.body: Because the Ford EcoBoost is fitted to six different models — from the compact Ford EcoBoost to the grand-touring Ford EcoBoost roadster — compatibility comes down to confirming your exact model, generation, and specific exact variant (e.g., "45" vs "45 S" vs "43"). A Ford EcoBoost from an Ford EcoBoost isn't a drop-in match for a Ford EcoBoost from an Ford EcoBoost — ancillaries and mounting differ.
